name: The Lich's Identity
summary: Bethor Iceshard seeks to learn who lives alone on Brightwater Lake. He sends an emissary to steal the recluse's spellbook and judge his power and allegiance.

sections.title: A Recluse on the Lake
sections.body: A lone lich lives in exile on a small island in Brightwater Lake, north of the Undercity. He has free will, unlike the Lich King's mindless pawns, but paranoia rules his life. He believes any undead who approach are Scourge thralls sent to drag him back into servitude. So he unleashes summoned minions on anyone who sets foot on his shore.

sections.title: A Valuable Asset
sections.body: Word of the rogue lich reaches Bethor Iceshard, the archmage who oversees the Undercity's mages. Bethor knows Lady Sylvanas Windrunner seeks every scrap of magical mastery and every capable will to strengthen the Forsaken against their many foes. To judge whether the hermit can be recruited, Bethor needs proof of his identity and necromantic skill.

sections.title: An Old Friend Found
sections.body: When the stolen spellbook reaches the Magic Quarter, Bethor studies its arcane script and learns the lich's identity: Gunther Arcanus. Before the plague ravaged Lordaeron, Gunther was a talented necromancer and Bethor's close comrade. His independent will and greater necromantic power could aid the Dark Lady's realm.

faq.q: Who sends you on this mission?
faq.answer: Bethor Iceshard, a powerful Forsaken mage in the Undercity's Magic Quarter, sends you.

faq.q: Why does the lich attack anyone who approaches him?
faq.answer: The lich freed himself from the Lich King's control, but wrongly believes every other undead in Lordaeron remains a mind-controlled Scourge thrall. He orders his minions to attack anyone approaching his island to protect his freedom.

faq.q: Where is the lich's camp located?
faq.answer: The lich lives on an island in Brightwater Lake, in Tirisfal Glades directly north of the Ruins of Lordaeron and Undercity.

faq.q: Why does Lady Sylvanas want him brought into the Forsaken?
faq.answer: Lady Sylvanas seeks rare, independent undead with great magical skill. A free-willed necromancer wielding potent death magic could help the Forsaken fight the Scourge and the Scarlet Crusade.

faq.q: Who does the lich turn out to be?
faq.answer: Bethor reveals that the lich is Gunther Arcanus, a former Dalaran mage and skilled necromancer who was Bethor's close comrade-in-arms before the Third War.

faq.q: What happens after you deliver the spellbook?
faq.answer: After confirming Gunther's identity, Bethor sends you back to Brightwater Lake with the spellbook. You are to convince Gunther that the Forsaken are free and want to welcome him.

angles.text: As a Forsaken, you know that freeing independent undead proves your break from the Lich King's control was no isolated miracle. Their necromantic power can also strengthen Sylvanas's court.
As a mage, you see Bethor Iceshard in the Magic Quarter carry on Lordaeron's and Dalaran's magical traditions in service of Forsaken survival.
As a member of the Horde, you know powerful necromancers can strengthen its northern frontier against the Scarlet Crusade and the Scourge.
